name: Clark Wright
headline: Founder at GTM37 | AI Enthusiast
about:
I founded GTM37 to democratize the same marketing strategies and tactics I learned in high-growth startups by making them accessible to Main Street. 

We provide local, service-based businesses the same strategies, tools, and tactics used by venture scaled startups and big tech, adapted for their markets and customers, helping them grow their businesses.
… more

experiences.description:
After decades building go-to-market systems for high-growth and scaling B2B SaaS startups, I recognized a critical gap: the digital marketing strategies that worked for big tech weren't accessible to the service businesses in our communities. Local contractors, healthcare providers, and professional services were drowning in confusing marketing advice and cookie-cutter solutions that didn't deliver results.

I co-founded GTM37 to democratize enterprise-grade marketing strategies for small, locally-oriented service businesses. We specialize in Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) – ensuring our clients become the definitive answer when potential customers ask AI platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini for recommendations. We deliver results through a blend of technical website optimization, Content Marketing, and Social Media Managment.

Oversaw Product, Marketing, and Partnerships for Chain.io, a B2B SaaS integration platform serving the logistics and supply chain industry. Played a key leadership role in aligning cross-functional teams around customer value, market fit, and strategic growth opportunities.

Led efforts to evolve Chain.io’s product development approach by advocating for empowered teams, outcome-focused planning, and continuous discovery practices. Worked across Engineering, Customer Success, and GTM to improve how product decisions were made, how success was measured, and how user needs informed the roadmap.

Drove adoption of AI to streamline repetitive tasks and improve operational efficiency — freeing teams to spend more time on high-impact product discovery, user and partner experience research, innovation, and tech debt reduction.

Led the Network team which was responsible for expanding Chain.io’s technology partners and ecosystem of connected applications — a core component of customer value delivery. Worked cross-functionally with Partner Managers, Sales, Product, Engineering, Finance, and external integration partners to identify, prioritize, and enable new connectivity options across the platform.

In parallel, provided executive oversight to Chain.io’s Marketing team. I provided the "voice of the partner" ensure they were incorporated into messaging and campaigns along with brand awareness, product marketing, thought leadership, and event-based marketing efforts. Ensured that marketing campaigns positioned the company’s integration value proposition to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Launched Chain.io’s technology partner program, with a focus on expanding the company’s connectivity ecosystem through strategic partnerships. Focused on business development, pipeline generation, and formalizing the structure, process, and messaging behind Chain.io’s partner engagement model.

Worked closely with Product, Marketing, and Sales to align partner strategy with platform priorities and revenue goals, helping position Chain.io as a more integrated and extensible solution for mid-market and enterprise logistics service providers and the software companies that serve them.

Held full accountability for overseeing sales performance and executing channel sales strategy to enhance overall business development. Provided sales enablement and training for largest channel partners - Sprint & T-Mobile, with over 600 field sales reps spanning SMB, MMB, Enterprise, SLED, and FED teams . Sold shoulder to shoulder with account managers, authorized business dealers, and field sales reps; helped to build a collaborative sales culture.

Partnered closely with sales teams from Geotab's largest channel partners with tools, strategy, and training to position Geotab's commercial GPS/Telematics hardware and SaaS products as part of their offerings.   Acted as an SME and solutions engineer to partner sales teams to support a technical use case while simplifying complex topics making it easy for partners to sell and end users to buy. Governed business critical areas including strategic planning, service management, and marketing.
